All three items read on the Visit Henry County calendar on 2 Oct 2026 and each venue confirmed on its own page: Electrify Expo (Oct 10-11, EchoPark Speedway, 1500 Tara Place, Hampton), Bags, Bands & Bites Oktoberfest (Oct 10, Rutabaga's Market & Cafe, 1 Cherry Street, Hampton, no time listed), 2026 Kiwanis Fair (Oct 13 6:00pm to Oct 18 10:00pm, Nash Farm Park, 4361 Jonesboro Road, Hampton). Earliest event is Oct 10, which is after the Oct 8 publish. Admission prices exist on the Electrify Expo page and are deliberately left off. Dropped: '3rd Annual Food Truck Fly-In' (no venue could be confirmed) and the Fall Georgia State Fair (already on the 1 Oct card).
headline:
A Busy Ten Days
In Hampton
titan_line: Echo, three things going on in Hampton over the next ten days. All three are still ahead of us as this goes up.

items.title: Electrify Expo
items.detail: EchoPark Speedway, 1500 Tara Place. Vehicle demos, plus go-kart racing for kids.

items.title: Bags, Bands & Bites Oktoberfest
items.detail: At Rutabaga's Market & Cafe, 1 Cherry Street. Times are on the county calendar.

items.title: Kiwanis Fair
items.detail: Nash Farm Park, 4361 Jonesboro Road. Opens Oct 13 at 6pm, runs to Oct 18 at 10pm.

echo_line: Three events, one town. …Oh, that's a lot of Hampton. I'd take the kids to the fair.
source: Visit Henry County Georgia events calendar · retrieved Oct 2, 2026
disclaimer: Dates as published by the organizers on the date retrieved. Confirm with each event before you go.
